mapper.select: SELECT l.lock_id as lockId, l.ip_address as ipAddress, l.sn_code as snCode, l.port_number as portNumber, l.switch_status as switchStatus, l.JSH as classroomNumber, l.remarks, c.SKDD as classroomName, c.XQMC as campusName, c.JZWMC as buildingName, c.floor FROM sys_lock_info l LEFT JOIN sys_classroom c ON l.JSH COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = c.JSH COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE l.lock_id = #{lockId}
